title: A foothold for restoration
notice: Fictional playtest: all amounts, areas, delays and results are configured placeholders. No ecological, financial, legal or grant forecast.

outline.title: Find your foothold
outline.description: Use personal land or buy a demonstrator parcel.

outline.title: Find support
outline.description: Apply, receive an award, then collect payment.

outline.title: Grow the work
outline.description: Expand restoration; optionally form a company.

outline.title: Connect more land
outline.description: Buy or obtain permission for additional parcels.

outline.title: Take stock
outline.description: Review land, cash, organizations and completed work.

actions.title: Use an existing personal parcel
actions.description: Bring a 2 ha personally owned parcel into the project. No purchase expenditure; its market value is not assessed.
actions.outcome: Personal parcel made available. Ownership remains with the individual; no market valuation is assigned.

actions.title: Buy a demonstrator parcel
actions.description: Acquire a 2 ha parcel for the individual initiating the project.
actions.outcome: Demonstrator parcel purchased by the individual. Cash expenditure is recorded separately from the land asset.

actions.title: Establish the demonstrator
actions.description: Carry out a small configured restoration trial on the starting parcel.
actions.outcome: Demonstrator completed: a fictional 1 ha restoration trial, ready to support a funding application.

actions.title: Apply for a restoration grant
actions.description: Submit a fictional application. An application adds no cash.
actions.outcome: Grant application submitted and pending. No award or payment has been received.

actions.title: Receive the grant decision
actions.description: Resolve the application with a configured €40,000 award. Payment remains a separate step.
actions.outcome: Fictional €40,000 grant awarded. The award is pending payment and is not available cash.

actions.title: Receive the grant payment
actions.description: Collect this award once, after the separate decision.
actions.outcome: Grant payment received once. The award amount is now included in available cash.

actions.title: Expand restoration
actions.description: Complete another 1 ha of restoration on a parcel with space remaining.
actions.outcome: An additional 1 ha restoration activity is completed on the selected parcel.

actions.title: Create a company
actions.description: Optional organizational step. Existing land stays with its current owner.
actions.outcome: Company established alongside the project. No land ownership or access has been transferred.

actions.title: Buy additional land
actions.description: Purchase a further 3 ha parcel for the individual. Organizations do not automatically receive it.
actions.outcome: Additional parcel purchased by the individual and available for restoration. No organizational transfer occurs.

actions.title: Agree access to more land
actions.description: Obtain restoration permission for a 3 ha third-party parcel; this does not convey ownership.
actions.outcome: Access agreement completed on third-party land for this fictional horizon. The project does not own the parcel.

actions.title: Establish a foundation
actions.description: Optional continuity step, with or without a company. Existing land arrangements remain intact.
actions.outcome: Foundation established. Any company continues to exist; parcel ownership and access remain unchanged.

actions.title: Advance time
actions.description: Move directly to a later year, up to year 30. No automatic income, costs or ecological changes occur.
actions.outcome: Time advanced. Existing assets and completed activities are retained; pending grants remain pending.
